name: ReflectionAccessError reports denial context without leaking inaccessible data

input.fixture_ref: Deny inspect and mutate operations across package and target scopes, catch ReflectionAccessError in Iris, and inspect its public fields and Host channel behavior.

applicability.reason: Requires HOST-configured ReflectionPolicy, so this belongs with the native/Host group. C108 needs a denial to report caller package, operation, target scope and denial origin; a denial can only arise from a policy C009 places under Host configuration.

expect.status: The ordinary Iris error reports caller package, operation, target scope and denial origin, leaks no inaccessible member data, and uses no Host-only failure channel.
